messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide you can follow to get your acoustic guitar sold quickly—and hopefully at a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1️⃣ Inspect & Clean** | Give it a thorough wipe down, check strings, bridge pins, nut slots, and look for cracks or warps. Replace worn parts if needed. | A well‑maintained guitar looks more valuable and reduces buyer hesitation. | | **2️⃣ Take High‑Quality Photos** | • Use natural light.
• Shoot from multiple angles (front, back, side, headstock).
• Include close‑ups of serial number, brand logo, and any flaws.
• Show the guitar playing (if possible) – a short video works great too! | Great visuals build trust and help buyers see exactly what they’re getting. | | **3️⃣ Write a Clear Description** | • Brand + Model
• Year / age estimate
• Body wood, neck material, finish
– Condition notes (new/used, repairs)
- Included accessories (case, strap, picks)
- Any recent maintenance (tuning, new strings)
- Reason for selling | Transparency prevents disputes later and speeds up negotiations. | | **4️⃣ Research Pricing** | • Check completed listings on eBay, Reverb, Etsy, Amazon, and local sites like Craigslist/Facebook Marketplace.
• Look at similar models, ages, conditions.
• Decide whether you’ll set a firm price or start higher and allow bargaining. | Knowing market value keeps you competitive without underselling. | | **5️⃣ Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | *Online Marketplaces*
  - **Reverb.com** (great for musical gear, built‑in payment protection)
  - **eBay** (wide reach, auction option)
  - **Etsy** (handmade/fine instruments)
*Local Options*
  - **Craigslist**, **Facebook Marketplace**, **Nextdoor** (no fees, instant pickup)
*Specialty Stores*
  - Local music stores may buy used gear or offer consignment services | Using both online and local platforms maximizes exposure while keeping costs low. | | **6️⃣ Set Up Shipping (If Needed)** | • Pack carefully: use a hard case or padded gig bag, bubble wrap, foam inserts.
• Get insurance coverage for high‑value items.
• Provide tracking info to buyer. | Proper packaging protects the guitar during transit and gives peace of mind to both parties. | | **7️⃣ Handle Payment Safely** | • For online sales: PayPal Goods & Services, Venmo (with transaction record), or bank transfer via escrow service.
• Avoid cash unless meeting face‑to‑face. | Protects against fraud and ensures you receive funds before handing over the instrument. | | **8️⃣ Meet In Person (Optional)** | If using local classifieds, meet in a public place (coffee shop, police station parking lot). Bring a friend if possible. Verify identity, test playability briefly, then hand over money. | Reduces risk of scams and lets buyers confirm quality firsthand. | | **9️⃣ Close the Sale** | Once paid, ship immediately (or give keys if local sale). Send tracking details promptly. Ask buyer to leave feedback/review—positive reviews boost future sales. | Prompt delivery builds reputation and encourages repeat business. | ### Quick Tips & Common Pitfalls | Tip | Explanation | |-----|-------------| | **Price Flexibility** | Start slightly above target price so there’s room to negotiate. | | **Honesty About Flaws** | Disclose scratches, dents, or past repairs upfront. Buyers appreciate transparency. | | **Avoid “Too Good To Be True” Offers** | Lowball offers often signal scammers. Stick to realistic prices. | | **Use Secure Platforms** | Sites like Reverb handle payments and dispute resolution automatically. | | **Keep Records** | Save screenshots of ads, receipts, and communication logs. Helpful if issues arise. | --- #### Sample Listing Template ``` Title: Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar - Excellent Condition, New Strings Description: Brand: Yamaha Model: FG800 Year: ~2018 (approx.) Body Wood: Spruce top, Mahogany back & sides Neck: Maple Finish: Natural gloss Condition: Light wear, no major blemishes. Recently had new strings installed. Accessories: Original case, strap, pick holder. Serial #: YG12345678 Why I'm selling: Moving out of state. Asking Price: $350 (negotiable) Photos attached. Feel free to ask questions! Payment accepted via PayPal or Cash App. Will ship within 48 hrs after receiving payment. ``` Feel free to tweak this template to match your guitar’s specifics. Happy selling! 🎸
